Existing frozen legacy code is not a validated PlutoLib port. The registered piece/marker contracts and original tree cap, grass selection and initial vine behavior pass production consumer tests. Native explicit commands intentionally bypass natural biome restrictions. Natural starts, save-reload/LAN and independently observed entity-ignore behavior remain unverified. Original generated End templates were audited: existing runtime NBT differs only by replacing ender_slime_fluid with structure_void in both palettes. Original bytes are retained as references; full fluid/island parity is not claimed. Parked pending runtime and remaining behavior, not because no extension path exists.
